chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Regarding a woman: when the time of salat (prayer) begins while she is ṭāhirah (ritually pure), and she delays the salat until she menstruates, he said: “She makes it up when she becomes pure.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the obligatory salat (prayer) due at its prescribed time
key_terms.تَقْضِي: she performs the missed prayer later as make-up
key_terms.حَاضَتْ: she entered the state of menstruation
key_terms.طَاهِرَةٌ: ritually pure, not in a state of menstruation
key_terms.طَهُرَتْ: she became pure again after menstruation
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the appointed time for the obligation of the prayer to begin

ai.seo_question: If a woman delays salat until menstruation begins after the prayer time has entered, must she make up that prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman who was ritually pure at the beginning of the prayer time but delayed the salat until menstruation began. It states that she must perform the missed prayer as qada' after she becomes pure again.
